dump:
WITH dump (tbl, ord, j) AS (
  SELECT 'account', row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id), to_jsonb(t) FROM account t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'thread', row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, thread_key), to_jsonb(t)
    FROM thread t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'participant', row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, fb_user_id),
    to_jsonb(t) FROM participant t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'thread_participant',
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, thread_key, fb_user_id), to_jsonb(t)
    FROM thread_participant t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'message', row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, thread_key, message_id),
    to_jsonb(t) FROM message t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'message_reaction',
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, thread_key, message_id, actor_id), to_jsonb(t)
    FROM message_reaction t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'message_attachment',
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, thread_key, message_id, attachment_key), to_jsonb(t)
    FROM message_attachment t
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sync_state', row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, loop), to_jsonb(t)
    FROM sync_state t
)
SELECT jsonb_object_agg(tbl, rows)::text FROM (
  SELECT d.tbl, jsonb_agg(n.j ORDER BY d.ord) AS rows
    FROM dump d
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT jsonb_object_agg(e.key, CASE
              WHEN e.key IN ('updated_at', 'last_harvest_at', 'last_run_at', 'last_error_at', 'last_auth_error_at')
                THEN to_jsonb(e.value <> 'null'::jsonb)
              WHEN c.data_type = 'timestamp with time zone' AND e.value <> 'null'::jsonb
                THEN to_jsonb(
                  (extract(epoch FROM (e.value #>> '{}')::timestamptz) * 1000)::bigint)
              ELSE e.value END) AS j
       FROM jsonb_each(d.j) e
       JOIN information_schema.columns c
         ON c.table_schema = 'public' AND c.table_name = d.tbl AND c.column_name = e.key
   ) n
   GROUP BY d.tbl
) per_table
